rationale: A consistently reacts to inputs (touch → lean-in, call at t=20 → reorient to PERSON_ALPHA, offer food → lean-in, present ball → attend, startle → lean-away) and shows multiple spontaneous but sensible focus shifts (to PLAY_MIRROR at t=18 and 78–83, PLAY_BALL at t=30, PERSON_BETA at t=54–65, SEALED_GATE at t=66–67), then recovers after startle and resumes exploratory attention. B responds to touch, food, and startle but ignores the call (t=20) and the presented ball (t=44), and spends long spans with attention NONE (t=40–67 and 72–95) despite stimuli, showing less adaptive change and fewer coherent, self-initiated activities.
